subject.title: fix(agents): preserve streamed assistant text when Claude CLI result event is empty

question: Should OpenClaw preserve already-streamed Claude CLI assistant text when the final stream-json result event is empty, instead of treating the empty terminal result as canonical fallback input?
rationale: The patch is technically narrow and proof-positive, but it intentionally changes message-delivery precedence for a provider edge case where both streamed deltas and an empty terminal result exist.

options.title: Accept streamed-text preservation
options.body: Merge the parser fix so accumulated Claude text is delivered while genuinely empty turns still hit the existing empty_response path.

options.title: Keep final result canonical
options.body: Reject or close this PR and keep fallback behavior whenever the terminal result is empty, even after non-empty deltas were streamed.

options.title: Require a narrower owner change
options.body: Ask for a replacement that removes the unused telemetry flag or handles only one parser path, accepting more churn before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept streamed-text preservation
recommendation.body: Merge the parser fix so accumulated Claude text is delivered while genuinely empty turns still hit the existing empty_response path.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is currently assigned to steipete, and Peter Steinberger's history is central to the Claude CLI parser/runner surface.
